causality_tests.failure_condition: Any target at or before the original cutoff changes.
causality_tests.name: future_truncation
causality_tests.procedure: Recompute after deleting every bar and funding row later than each decision cutoff.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Any target at or before the corruption boundary changes.
causality_tests.name: future_corruption
causality_tests.procedure: Replace all post-boundary numeric values with extreme finite sentinels.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Appending later observations changes the prefix targets or internal prefix feature hashes.
causality_tests.name: append_invariance
causality_tests.procedure: Compare a prefix-only replay with the identical prefix of an extended replay.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Two clean processes differ in target bytes, feature hashes, or tie resolution.
causality_tests.name: deterministic_rerun
causality_tests.procedure: Replay identical frozen inputs in two clean processes with canonical worker/runtime seed 20260801. Namespace 2026080102 may identify the team-scoped tie-test case but is never passed to target_weights.

causality_tests.failure_condition: A row with close_time or funding_time after c(t) affects a target at t.
causality_tests.name: availability_boundary
causality_tests.procedure: Inject boundary-adjacent rows on both sides of c(t)=t-8h and assert the strict masks.

decision_contract.execution_lag: central next-open fill after the decision; the execution open is not visible
decision_contract.insufficient_state_action: return an empty mapping to request flat
decision_contract.rebalance_schedule: integer boundary index j=(t-1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)/8h; rebalance iff j modulo rebalance_bars is zero; baseline rebalance_bars=3

derived_features.missing_rule: pair is missing if either close is absent, non-finite, or non-positive

derived_features.availability_lag: inherits the latest included symbol return
derived_features.formula: cross-sectional median of valid symbol_log_return_8h among the current point-in-time eligible set
derived_features.fitting_rule: recomputed independently at each historical bar using only symbols and rows known at t
derived_features.missing_rule: historical bar is missing if fewer than 12 eligible symbols have valid returns

derived_features.fitting_rule: paired causal observations, ddof=0, exact fixed window; no intercept is exported and no state is fitted across decisions
derived_features.missing_rule: missing unless paired count is at least ceil(f_min*W) and two, and population common variance is greater than 1e-12

derived_features.fitting_rule: complete exact-grid horizon returns plus causal ddof=0 trailing volatility
derived_features.missing_rule: missing if beta is invalid, population volatility is <=1e-12, or any expected horizon return slot is invalid

derived_features.fitting_rule: exact-equality average rank mapped by 2*(rank-1)/(n-1)-1; symbol order does not break numeric rank ties
derived_features.missing_rule: symbol excluded from this leg when either horizon is invalid
symbol excluded from this leg when the reversal horizon is invalid

derived_features.formula: cumulative_funding=fsum(funding_rate) for unique event keys satisfying c-L_funding*24h < funding_time <= c, then exact average rank of -cumulative_funding
derived_features.fitting_rule: realized trailing event rates only; at least two unique events per ranked symbol and four ranked symbols cross-sectionally; no cadence normalization, predicted funding, scaling, or forward fill
derived_features.missing_rule: any duplicate (symbol,funding_time), any non-finite in-window rate, or fewer than two unique valid events maps that symbol to neutral 0 after valid-only ranking; fewer than four valid symbols maps every funding score to 0

derived_features.availability_lag: all return inputs end at c(t)
derived_features.fitting_rule: fixed formula and thresholds; recomputed at every scheduled decision
derived_features.missing_rule: invalid if the common series lacks minimum history or fewer than 12 symbols have a valid horizon return

derived_features.availability_lag: maximum lag of all component inputs
derived_features.fitting_rule: fixed convex blend followed by contemporaneous rank
derived_features.missing_rule: requires valid trend and reversal; missing funding is neutral rather than imputed cross-time
missing if the exact common horizon is incomplete; a complete all-zero common window produces D=0

derived_features.availability_lag: uses only composite ranks, volatility, and direction known at c(t)
derived_features.formula: K=max(4,floor(q*N)); first/last K of (A,symbol) ascending; type-7 clipped inverse population volatility; G_long=G/2+dD and G_short=G/2-dD; deterministic 0.095-cap water filling
derived_features.fitting_rule: exact rational q, deterministic ordering, and 1e-12 weight tolerance; organizer limits remain authoritative
derived_features.missing_rule: request flat if fewer than 12 total valid symbols or fewer than four names can populate either sleeve

formal_pivot_required_for: fixing the persistence state P to a constant
removing the residual-reversal leg or its causal interaction
mechanism_identity_guardrail.mandatory_identity: Every deployable family candidate retains residual persistence, residual reversal, and their causal variable-P interaction.
mechanism_identity_guardrail.statement: Diagnostic ablations cannot become this family's champion regardless of performance.

allocation.failure_behavior: If either side is infeasible or reconciliation fails tolerance, request the whole scheduled portfolio flat; never emit one side alone.
allocation.feasible_budget: B_eff=min(B,K*0.095); any difference B-B_eff remains cash and is not redistributed to unselected names.
allocation.raw_score: inverse of population symbol volatility after type-7 10th/90th percentile clipping
allocation.reconciliation: First reject values outside [-1e-12,0.095+1e-12], project boundary roundoff to [0,0.095], then correct only the float residual in descending headroom (positive) or descending weight (negative), then ASCII symbol order, bounded by headroom/current weight. Require final [0,0.095] bounds and sum tolerance; never renormalize deliberate cash.
allocation.water_filling: In each simultaneous round propose remaining_budget*a_i/fsum(active a); cap every proposal >=0.095-1e-12, remove it, and repeat. Assign all proposals when no cap binds. If a cap round leaves remaining budget <=1e-12, leave still-active weights at zero and reconcile; likewise stop if active empties. Only a nonempty set with budget >1e-12 and nonpositive/nonfinite score sum is infeasible.

arithmetic.reduction_order: time ascending; symbols ASCII ascending; accurate deterministic float64 sum semantics

funding.duplicate_behavior: Any repeated (symbol,funding_time) key inside the window invalidates that symbol's whole funding statistic for that decision, even when repeated values agree; the symbol receives neutral zero after valid-only ranking.
funding.formula: cumulative_funding=fsum(funding_rate) in ascending funding_time order; F is the exact average rank of its negative
funding.interface_correction: The worker exposes normalized realized funding_time, symbol, funding_rate, and mark_price, but no interval metadata. Cumulative actual event rates preserve the registered realized-funding mechanism and need no fixed positive scaling for ranks.
funding.mark_price_usage: intentionally unused for signal calculation, validity, and ranking; central evaluation owns funding cashflows
funding.neutral_rule: A duplicate key, non-finite in-window rate, or fewer than two unique valid events invalidates the symbol. Rank only valid symbols, then assign zero to invalid symbols; if fewer than four valid symbols, assign zero to all.
funding.scaling: none; any fixed positive scaling would leave cross-sectional ranks unchanged

history_and_startup.complete_horizons: fast, slow, reversal, common ER/D, and breadth cumulative-return horizons require every expected slot
history_and_startup.estimation_fraction: f_min is exact 4/5 or 9/10; beta/volatility requires n_valid >= ceil(f_min*W) and at least two
history_and_startup.flat_condition: Fewer than 12 scoreable symbols, 2*K>N, or either infeasible side requests flat at a scheduled decision.

moments.beta: paired population covariance divided by population common variance, ddof=0; variance <=1e-12 is invalid; clip result to [-1,3]
moments.residual_z: uses population symbol volatility and sqrt(number of complete horizon slots); no residual-series standard deviation
moments.symbol_volatility: population standard deviation, ddof=0, shared by z, quantiles, and weights; <=1e-12 is invalid

quantile.definition: Hyndman-Fan type 7: u=(N-1)*p, j=floor(u), g=u-j, Q=(1-g)*s[j]+g*s[min(j+1,N-1)]
quantile.population: all N finite positive scoreable-symbol population volatilities before sleeve selection

ranking_and_state.rank: Exact-equality average one-based ascending rank mapped to 2*(r-1)/(n-1)-1; no tolerance tie break; n<2 invalid.
ranking_and_state.selection_tie_order: single (composite alpha ascending, symbol ASCII ascending) ordering; first K short and last K long

return_windows.expected_slots: For W=3h returns, return-end bar open_time values are c-8h through c-W*8h on the exact 8h grid; W+1 closes are needed.
return_windows.invalid_slot: missing/non-grid/duplicate adjacency or a non-finite/non-positive close; no fill or interpolation
return_windows.window_sides: rightmost return end included; left boundary close is denominator-only

forbidden_inputs: organizer regime labels as strategy features
evaluator positions, fills, equity, or PnL

raw_inputs.coverage_statement: Authorized public Binance USD-M 8h transaction-bar history streamed only for the current organizer-eligible symbols; empirical coverage is not assumed before evaluation.
raw_inputs.missing_data_rule: no backfill; require exact 8h open_time adjacency, reject duplicate/gapped/non-finite/non-positive closes, require the frozen count rule
raw_inputs.source: organizer-streamed canonical Binance USD-M transaction klines

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp_rule: funding_time; neutral worker supplies only rows strictly earlier than decision_time
raw_inputs.coverage_statement: Normalized actual historical funding events for currently eligible symbols. Event cadence is preserved and cumulative funding_rate measures actual per-notional rates accrued over the fixed wall-time window.
raw_inputs.missing_data_rule: no interpolation or forward fill; duplicate event key, non-finite rate, or fewer than two unique trailing events yields neutral carry score
raw_inputs.source: organizer-streamed canonical Binance USD-M realized funding rows

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp_rule: organizer supplies membership at decision_time after causal weekly reconstitution
raw_inputs.coverage_statement: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC point-in-time Top-40 liquidity membership intersected with symbols having an executable next open.
raw_inputs.missing_data_rule: never synthesize membership; an empty/insufficient set requests flat
raw_inputs.strategy_lag: available at decision_time; underlying membership uses completed prior UTC days

supervised_target.embargo: Outcome-based fold-local selection must end strictly before fold_start minus 30 calendar days. Embargoed raw observations may initialize causal feature state after parameters freeze, and no canonical visible-development date is omitted from scoring.
supervised_target.label_overlap_purge: not applicable because the strategy has no supervised forward-return label
supervised_target.selection_outcome: central next-open, net-of-cost portfolio returns are used only after the corresponding candidate was registered
supervised_target.statement: No forward target is used to train a model. Rolling estimates are past-only features. The six contiguous folds score the complete canonical [2020-02-03, 2023-07-01) window exactly once; [2020-01-01, 2020-02-03) is state-only warmup.
